description: Your plan payments made in USDC on Ethereum (GET /api/v1/pay/status), read from WakeTrades' records only. With tx (the 0x-prefixed hash of the transaction you sent): tx.state is pending (not seen yet: wait about a minute and ask again), applied (the plan is on, with planExpiresAt) or review (amount or sender to be checked by our team: do not pay again, write to support@waketrades.com with the hash). Do not pay again while pending: check your own transaction receipt (status 0 = reverted, nothing was paid); still pending after 20 minutes, write to support@waketrades.com with the hash. Without tx: payments, your applied Ethereum payments (tx, amount, receivedAt, plan, planExpiresAt).
name: get_payment_status
title: Status of a payment on Ethereum
